messages:
Ava: Quick sync — proposing a joint design review for the new multi-API contract (server streaming + SDK helpers) + Console UX updates. Need 45m to cover API, SDK ergonomics, and Console previewing.
Priya: +1. can we get the pre-read up before EOD Tuesday?
Luca: Works for me. prefer morning slots.
Noah: also +1. can we include the integration smoke-test plan in the pre-read? saves time in the meeting.
Maya: I can own the smoke-test checklist, will add it to the doc tomorrow.
Ava: plan: share pre-read doc w/ links to PR, mockups, and a short checklist. ask reviewers to skim specific sections:
```
- API: design intent + compatibility notes (Priya)
- SDK: convenience helpers + examples (Luca)
- Console: flows and screenshots (Maya)
- Regression checklist & quick smoke test (Maya)
```
Ava: Proposed slots (please react with :one:/:two:/:three: or reply):
1) Wed 9:30–10:15 PT
2) Thu 10:00–10:45 PT
3) Fri 13:00–13:45 PT
Priya: I'll take slot 1 if available.
Luca: slot 2 preferred.
Noah: slot 1 or 3 works for me.
Maya: leaning 3. I'll still publish the smoke-test tomorrow AM.
Ava: I'll collate RSVPs by EOD and lock the time. Quick ask for pre-read: please comment inline on the API compatibility paragraph (Priya wrote it) and leave any SDK ergonomics asks in the examples section.
Priya: will do. pinging @deploy-bot to include the staging preview link when the build completes.
deploy-bot: Build #283 on staging queued. Preview URL will be posted here when available.
Ava: attaching initial pre-read (doc link): https://redwood.docs/drive/multi-api-sdk-console-pre-read. PRs: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/512 and https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/513.
Luca: added local SDK snippet for the examples section — please check `Client.async_stream()` example.
Noah: can we keep the review focused: 10m API, 15m SDK, 15m Console, 5m action items?
Maya: ack. I'll prepare annotated screenshots and a small checklist:
```
- smoke: basic auth, stream start/stop, error surface
- telemetry: events fired for start/stop
- UX fallback: long-running stream state
```
Ava: perfect. final ask: if you're a primary reviewer, add your name under "expected reviewers" in the doc so we can triage Qs pre-meeting. I'll follow up with a calendar invite once slot is chosen. :calendar:
Priya: added.
Luca: added.
Noah: added.
Maya: added and linked the staging preview placeholder.
Ava: thanks everyone — will post final slot by 18:00 and ping again once preview link lands. :thumbsup:
_meta_note: This file is a single Slack thread string; messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names as required.
